qualification.details: Minimum Graduate/Diploma Holder (any discipline) as Full-time Regular course from Institutes/Colleges/Universities/Deemed Universities duly recognized by AICTE/UGC. Minimum 25 years of working experience in upstream oil and gas sector in any Govt./PSU/Private Sector on permanent basis, out of which minimum 10 years of experience in Well Services/Workover rigs including minimum 5 years of dedicated experience in Cased Hole/Well Services Fishing. Must have retired at least from the post of Deputy General Manager (Grade F) or equivalent post.

content_sections.heading: Oil India Consultant Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 1 vacancy is available – 1 for the Consultant (Fishing) post.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Minimum Graduate/Diploma Holder (any discipline) as Full-time Regular course from Institutes/Colleges/Universities/Deemed Universities duly recognized by AICTE/UGC. Minimum 25 years of working experience in upstream oil and gas sector in any Govt./PSU/Private Sector on permanent basis, out of which minimum 10 years of experience in Well Services/Workover rigs including minimum 5 years of dedicated experience in Cased Hole/Well Services Fishing. Must have retired at least from the post of Deputy General Manager (Grade F) or equivalent post.

content_sections.heading: Oil India Consultant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Oil India Consultant (Fishing) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 28-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Oil India Consultant (Fishing) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Oil India Consultant (Fishing) recruitment is 28 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Consultant (Fishing) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Consultant (Fishing) position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 1,50,000/-.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum qualification and experience required?
faq.answer: A minimum Graduate/Diploma Holder (any discipline) with 25 years of experience in the upstream oil and gas sector, including specific experience in well services and fishing, is required. The candidate must have retired at a Deputy General Manager (Grade F) or equivalent level.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Consultant (Fishing) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Consultant (Fishing) post is 63 years.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Oil India Consultant (Fishing) job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email by sending their complete application with all necessary documents to the official email address provided in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Consultant (Fishing) post will be based on a Personal Interaction.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by Oil India.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is HRAQ/CONT-EX-B/26-299.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity.
